summary: The link_exists test checks whether a symlink itself exists on the controller without following it, so broken links still count.
questions: How do I detect a broken symlink on the controller?
What's the difference between exists and link_exists?

answer_card.title: link_exists test
answer_card.answer_md: `path is link_exists` checks the link itself on the **controller** without following it, so a dangling symlink still returns true. `exists` follows the link to its target.
